title: Japanese Lamb Dumplings
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Ukrainian flavors, these lamb dumplings are a tasty twist on traditional Japanese cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine ground lamb, chopped kidney, chopped scallions, and chopped dill. Mix well with your hands or a wooden spoon until just combined.
2. Lay a dumpling wrapper on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of the lamb mixture in the center of the wrapper.
3. Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
4. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling.
5. Repeat with the remaining dumpling wrappers and lamb mixture.
6. In a large pot or steamer, bring 2 inches of water to a boil. Reduce the heat to medium-low and place a steamer basket over the water.
7. Place the dumplings in the steamer basket and cover with a lid.
8. Steam the dumplings for 10-12 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
9. Serve the dumplings hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
